svg.title: Inside /tk:document
svg.desc: Document follows review once the review loop has settled. It updates the README, CLAUDE.md, the changelog, the lessons and the design profile, and runs index when the codebase map is missing or 10 or more commits old. It looks for the places you corrected Claude and keeps them in a private correction ledger on your machine, saving nothing until you accept it. It commits, writes the cycle page saying what changed and why, and in a worktree pushes the branch and opens a pull request. The line ends here.
